title: Bertoni 2026 · Experiment 1 · Awake and sleep EEG
citation: Bertoni, T., Ricci, G., Jöhr, J., et al. (2026). Multisensory integration in peripersonal space indexes consciousness states in sleep and disorders of consciousness. Cell Reports Medicine, 7(4), 102705.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.response: Primary outcome comes from synchronized passive EEG. No overt trial response is required.
published_method.index: Contrast auditory near minus auditory far with audio-tactile near minus audio-tactile far, using poststimulus high-beta power (20–30 Hz).
published_method.stimulus: Stationary 100 ms white noise at 30 cm or 130 cm above the chest, equalized at the ear. Deliver a chest electrocutaneous event 2 cm below the manubrium with Digitimer DS7AH, after individual intensity matching.
published_method.overnight_assessment: Run five-minute stimulation and unstimulated periods from about 23:30 to 06:30, with assessment in N2, N3 and REM. The report uses both alternation and randomization language. Obtain serial awakening reports and analyze the 20 s before NREM awakenings for the pre-awakening comparison.

implementation_gaps: Deliver calibrated simultaneous electrical pulses and calibrated sound from two chest-relative positions while synchronizing EEG event codes.
The overnight branch requires polysomnographic staging, stimulation control, scheduled awakenings, and source-specific dream-report classification.
Resolve the healthy-awake jitter grid and overnight stimulation/awakening schedule against event logs. Validate artifact handling, montage and spectral index on the acquisition route.
